items.entity: Downward load at the free end
items.description: The arrows originate along the lower free-end edge, while the load label uses surface-traction units. The loaded region is not specified in the text.
readings: Uniform downward surface traction over the entire 1 m by 1 m free-end face.
Uniform downward line load along the 1 m lower edge of the free end.
items.evidence: Fig. 3 (left): arrow row along the lower free-end edge and load label in N/m². Sec. 6.1.1 provides no verbal specification of the loaded region.

items.entity: Material allowance corresponding to the bound 0.5
items.description: The stated mass bound has no units or normalization, whereas Eq. (1) constrains absolute material volume.
readings: A normalized material-volume fraction of 0.5, allowing 1.5 m³ in the 3 m³ box.
An absolute material-volume bound of 0.5 m³ in Eq. (1), giving a volume fraction of 1/6.
items.evidence: Sec. 6.1.1 states that the upper bound for the mass constraint is 0.5. Eq. (1) defines the constraint as sum_i(mu_i v_i) <= v_u. Fig. 3 (left) gives dimensions of 3 m by 1 m by 1 m.
